findings: SW-RIB-SWM01 Q3A requires a candidate signed SWAP transfer to be compared with the externally realized feasible transfer before SWAP commit; mismatch requires discard and recomposition from the same accepted origins.

The current PA01 wrapper binds accepted external heads and delegates directly to the ordinary serialized executor, which may commit the SWAP interval before any external realized-transfer receipt is compared.
F-APP09 implements the missing checkpoint -> trial -> realized-transfer comparison -> discard/replay or sole commit boundary.

PA01 selects the Q1H epsilon=1e-5 legacy STTAB emulation while F-APP09's first production profile selects Ribasim-native surface-water geometry. Both are defensible but they are not the same V1 profile.

disposition.transaction_authority: F-APP09 participant candidate must qualify before full coupled admission.
disposition.geometry_authority: Choose and name the production geometry profile explicitly. Do not silently combine RIBASIM_NATIVE and Q1H_LEGACY_EMULATION under one profile id.

allowed_work: PA01 tests may continue as diagnostics for typed accepted-head binding, owner-XOR and Q4B mass behavior.
No independent or canonical admission claim for the general coupled profile may use a PA01 candidate PASS until this hold is reconciled.
forbidden_claims: PA01 candidate PASS proves cross-model availability/recomposition.
Q1H epsilon geometry and Ribasim-native geometry are interchangeable.
PA01 supersedes the F-APP09 transaction participant.
